name: What Made the Plague
description: Iron Mother has traced the manufactured plague that killed her patients to a pre-war biotech facility east of Nairobi. She needs someone to go in, recover the synthesis records, and if possible destroy the remaining stock.

stages.name: Reach the Biotech Facility
stages.description: Travel east of Nairobi to the pre-war biotechnology facility Iron Mother has located. She warns the facility may still have automated security.

stages.name: Access the Synthesis Records
stages.description: Find the facility's research database and extract the plague synthesis records. Iron Mother needs to know who created it and what it was designed to do.

stages.name: Destroy the Remaining Pathogen Stock
stages.description: The synthesis records indicate a remaining stockpile in the facility's cold storage. Destroy it before it can spread further.

stages.name: Return to Iron Mother
stages.description: Return to Nairobi with the synthesis records and confirmation of the stockpile's destruction.
